content: Pandoc User's Guide: the 'lang' metadata variable (BCP-47, e.g. pt-BR) controls hyphenation in PDF output via babel (pdflatex) or polyglossia (xelatex), and affects smart-quote style and date localization in most formats. Omitting lang leaves English hyphenation, English-style generated text and English date forms in an otherwise pt-br PDF; passing it via --metadata lang=pt-BR is the standard fix.
